Who is bound: Victoria. 'regulated entity' means Melbourne Water Corporation, a metropolitan water corporation, a Regional Urban Water Authority or a Rural Water Authority (s 4A(1)). Clause text is paraphrased from the source. Not verified: Penalty and enforcement consequences under the Essential Services Commission Act 2001 (Vic) were not read. There is no direct penalty in s 4F itself.. A compliance SME must confirm before reliance.
summary: Water Industry Act 1994 (Vic) (No. 121 of 1994). Bound: Victoria. 'regulated entity' means Melbourne Water Corporation, a metropolitan water corporation, a Regional Urban Water Authority or a Rural Water Authority (s 4A(1)).

clauses.heading: Water Industry Standards
clauses.text: A regulated entity must comply with any provision of a Water Industry Standard that applies to it (s4F(6)).
clauses.notes: Provision read: s 4F(6). Statutory backing: any breach of the WIS-UCS clauses above by an agent acting for a Victorian water corporation is a breach of this statutory duty. Section 4F(1)-(2) empowers the ESC to make the standards, and s 187A(2) deems former Customer Service Codes to be Water Industry Standards.
